readme.markdown:
# send16-mcp

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/send16-mcp?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/send16-mcp)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/send16-mcp?color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/send16-mcp)
[![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-server-6E56CF)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/send16-mcp?color=3da639)](./LICENSE)

**The email API your AI agent can actually use.** A [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server for [Send16](https://send16.com) that gives Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client **79 tools** to send transactional & marketing email, manage contacts, audiences, segments, automations, templates, the inbox, suppressions, and webhooks — from natural language.

It ships a **zero-DNS sandbox sender**, so an agent can send its first real, delivered email in seconds with no domain setup.

```bash
npx send16-mcp
```

---

## Quick start

You need a Send16 API key (`sk_live_…`) from your [dashboard](https://send16.com/dashboard/developers). Then pick your client:

### Claude Desktop / Claude Code

`claude_desktop_config.json` (macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/`, Windows: `%APPDATA%\Claude\`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "send16": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "send16-mcp"],
      "env": { "SEND16_API_KEY": "sk_live_..." }
    }
  }
}
```

### Cursor

`.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "send16": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "send16-mcp"],
      "env": { "SEND16_API_KEY": "sk_live_..." }
    }
  }
}
```

Windsurf, VS Code, and any stdio-capable MCP client work the same way — run the `send16-mcp` binary with `SEND16_API_KEY` in the environment.

### Hosted (no install)

For clients that only speak *remote* MCP (Claude web connectors, ChatGPT custom GPTs), point them at the hosted endpoint and authenticate with your key:

```
https://mcp.send16.com
```

One connection, your own `sk_live_…` key — no install, no config file.

---

## First send in seconds — no DNS

Most email APIs make you verify a domain before you can send *anything*, which blocks an unattended agent on step one. Send16's sandbox sender doesn't:

1. Ask the agent to call `whoami` — it returns your workspace and your `sandbox_recipient` (your account owner's email).
2. Send `from: "onboarding@send16.com"` to that address. It delivers with **zero DNS setup**.
3. Verify a domain later to send to anyone.

> *"Send a test email from onboarding@send16.com to my account email with the subject 'It works'."*

---

## What it can do

79 tools across the platform, including:

- **Email** — `send_email` (single/batch/scheduled/attachments), transactional templates, delivery status.
- **Marketing** — campaigns, broadcasts, automations, segments, subscription topics.
- **Contacts** — create/search/list/import, audiences, tags, custom fields.
- **Deliverability** — domains, DNS health (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), IP warming & sending capacity.
- **Inbox** — read and manage transactional replies.
- **Webhooks** — create/list/rotate outgoing webhook endpoints (HMAC-SHA256 signed).

Every tool also accepts an optional `apiKey` parameter that overrides `SEND16_API_KEY`, so you can switch workspaces in one session.

## Environment

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SEND16_API_KEY` | Yes | Your Send16 key (`sk_live_…`) |
| `SEND16_API_URL` | No | API base URL (default: `https://api.send16.com`) |
| `SEND16_MCP_PORT` | No | If set, serves **Streamable HTTP** (multi-tenant) instead of stdio |

## Self-hosting the HTTP connector

Presence of `SEND16_MCP_PORT` flips the server into multi-tenant HTTP mode — each request carries its own `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_…`, threaded through the whole request, so one process serves many users:

```bash
docker build -t send16-mcp . && docker run -p 4242:4242 send16-mcp
```

## Develop

```bash
npm install
SEND16_API_KEY=sk_live_... npm run dev   # run from source
npm run build                            # bundle to dist/
```

## Links

- **Site & docs:** https://send16.com · https://send16.com/docs
- **npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/send16-mcp
- **Status:** https://status.send16.com

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Verify the API key and return the authenticated workspace: name, plan, email quota (used/limit), and owner. Call this first to confirm the key works before sending. Pair with list_domains to see which `from` addresses are allowed.

toolsPreview.name: send_email
toolsPreview.description: Send a transactional email through Send16. Provide `html`, `text`, or both (text-only is fine for OTPs/receipts/alerts). `from_email` must belong to a domain that is verified in the workspace — call `whoami` for the account and `list_domains` to see which senders are allowed; a send from an unverified domain returns a clear error, not a silent failure. For a zero-setup first send, use from_email `onboarding@send16.com` — the sandbox sender delivers with no DNS, but only to your own account email.

toolsPreview.name: send_campaign_test
toolsPreview.description: Send a test email for an existing campaign to preview how it will look in recipients' inboxes.

toolsPreview.name: create_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Create a new email campaign as a draft: optionally with full HTML content and recipients (exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll) so it's ready to test and send. Nothing is sent until schedule_campaign.

toolsPreview.name: design_email_template
toolsPreview.description: Use AI to generate a complete email HTML template based on a description. Returns ready-to-use HTML that can be sent or used in campaigns.

toolsPreview.name: list_campaigns
toolsPreview.description: List email campaigns, newest first. Use `search` to find a past campaign the user describes vaguely ('the invite one', 'that July newsletter') — it matches name and subject case-insensitively; try distinctive words from their description and broaden if no hits.

toolsPreview.name: create_contact
toolsPreview.description: Add a single new contact, optionally straight into audiences and/or with tags — e.g. 'add this person from my email into the newsletter list'. Contacts are subscribed by default. For more than a handful of people, use import_contacts instead.

toolsPreview.name: search_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Search contacts by email address or name. Returns matching contacts with their tags and subscription status.

toolsPreview.name: list_contacts
toolsPreview.description: List all contacts with optional filtering by subscription status and tag. Supports pagination.

toolsPreview.name: import_contacts
toolsPreview.description: Bulk import contacts from CSV data (min column: email), optionally straight into audiences and/or with tags. This is the tool for cross-app flows — e.g. pulling people out of Gmail, a CRM, or a spreadsheet and landing them in a Send16 audience in one call. Set updateExisting for upsert semantics (safe to re-run).

toolsPreview.name: list_domains
toolsPreview.description: List all sending domains configured in your Send16 workspace, including their verification status and DNS records.

toolsPreview.name: check_domain_health
toolsPreview.description: Check the DNS health of a specific domain, including DKIM, SPF, DMARC, and MX record verification status. Triggers a fresh DNS lookup.

toolsPreview.name: get_campaign_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed performance statistics for a specific campaign including open rate, click rate, bounce rate, and delivery metrics.

toolsPreview.name: get_deliverability_status
toolsPreview.description: Get your workspace's deliverability summary — sending reputation, domain authentication status, and recent bounce/complaint health. (Deliverability Hub plan feature.)

toolsPreview.name: list_automations
toolsPreview.description: List all automations in the workspace, including draft/active/paused status and trigger types.

toolsPreview.name: get_automation
toolsPreview.description: Get a single automation by ID, including its trigger, steps, and current status.

toolsPreview.name: enroll_in_automation
toolsPreview.description: Manually enroll a contact in an active automation. The automation must be in 'active' status. Use send_event for event-driven enrollment.

toolsPreview.name: send_event
toolsPreview.description: Fire a custom event for a contact. Automations whose trigger is `{type:'custom_event', eventName:'<name>'}` will enroll the contact and start running. Payload is exposed to condition steps as `event.<key>`.

toolsPreview.name: list_templates
toolsPreview.description: List starter-gallery email templates available to every workspace.

toolsPreview.name: get_template
toolsPreview.description: Get a single starter template by ID, including its EmailContent JSON.

toolsPreview.name: render_email_content
toolsPreview.description: Compile an EmailContent JSON object (the shape used by the Send16 builder + templates) into HTML using the platform's authoritative renderer. Returns the exact HTML the API would send. Useful for previews and post-processing.

toolsPreview.name: add_domain
toolsPreview.description: Register a new sending domain. Returns the DNS records the user must add to their DNS provider, after which they should call check_domain_health to verify.

toolsPreview.name: pre_send_review
toolsPreview.description: Run an AI pre-send review on an email's HTML before sending. Surfaces tone issues, broken links, missing alt text, spam triggers, and accessibility problems.

toolsPreview.name: generate_email_from_url
toolsPreview.description: Scrape a URL (e.g. a launch blog post or product page) and generate an email draft from its content. Returns subject, preview text, and HTML body.

toolsPreview.name: list_messages
toolsPreview.description: List messages from the unified send log (transactional + campaign). Filter by recipient, sender, status, date range, or source.

toolsPreview.name: get_message
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single message with its full event timeline (created → sent → delivered → opened → clicked → ...).

toolsPreview.name: get_message_events
toolsPreview.description: Get just the delivery event timeline for a message — no body or recipient details.

toolsPreview.name: list_convos
toolsPreview.description: List inbox conversations. Filter by state, mailbox, label, screener status, or full-text search. Send16's unified inbox combines transactional reply threading with team-managed shared inboxes.

toolsPreview.name: get_convo
toolsPreview.description: Get a single conversation with its full thread of posts (incoming + outgoing).

toolsPreview.name: send_reply
toolsPreview.description: Reply to an inbox conversation. The reply is sent from the original recipient address (the alias the convo arrived on) and threaded back to the contact.

toolsPreview.name: mark_convo_read
toolsPreview.description: Mark a conversation as read for the current viewer.

toolsPreview.name: update_convo
toolsPreview.description: Update conversation status (open/closed/archived/snoozed) or assignee.

toolsPreview.name: add_convo_note
toolsPreview.description: Add a private internal note on a conversation. Notes are visible only to workspace members.

toolsPreview.name: screener_decide
toolsPreview.description: Decide a pending screener conversation (first-time sender). 'allow' lets future emails through, 'reject' blocks, 'cold' marks as cold outreach.

toolsPreview.name: list_inbox_counts
toolsPreview.description: Get unread/total counts per category and label for the inbox sidebar (newsletter, transactional, marketing, calendar, social, cold).

toolsPreview.name: list_topics
toolsPreview.description: List subscription topics. Topics are granular categories contacts can subscribe to (e.g. 'product-updates', 'weekly-digest'). Campaigns and automations can be gated to subscribers of a specific topic.

toolsPreview.name: create_topic
toolsPreview.description: Create a new subscription topic. Contacts opt into topics individually via the preference center.

toolsPreview.name: update_topic
toolsPreview.description: Update a subscription topic (name, description, default).

toolsPreview.name: delete_topic
toolsPreview.description: Delete a subscription topic. All subscribers will be detached.

toolsPreview.name: list_actions
toolsPreview.description: List Actions. Actions fire a transactional template when a custom event arrives — Plunk-style 'event_name → template' pairings, simpler than full automations.

toolsPreview.name: get_action
toolsPreview.description: Get a single Action with its trigger config and template binding.

toolsPreview.name: create_action
toolsPreview.description: Create an Action that maps an event name to a transactional template. Each matching event sends one email to the contact.

toolsPreview.name: update_action
toolsPreview.description: Update an Action (toggle enabled, change template, change event name).

toolsPreview.name: delete_action
toolsPreview.description: Delete an Action.

toolsPreview.name: list_audiences
toolsPreview.description: List audiences (lists). An audience is a static, manually-managed group of contacts.

toolsPreview.name: create_audience
toolsPreview.description: Create a new audience.

toolsPreview.name: add_contacts_to_audience
toolsPreview.description: Add contacts (by ID) to an audience.

toolsPreview.name: remove_contact_from_audience
toolsPreview.description: Remove a contact from an audience.

toolsPreview.name: delete_audience
toolsPreview.description: Delete an audience (list). Contacts are not deleted — only the list and its memberships are removed.

toolsPreview.name: list_segments
toolsPreview.description: List dynamic segments. Segments compute their members from a filter expression at send time.

toolsPreview.name: preview_segment
toolsPreview.description: Preview the contacts that match a segment without sending.

toolsPreview.name: update_contact
toolsPreview.description: Update a contact's profile fields, custom fields, or subscription state.

toolsPreview.name: delete_contact
toolsPreview.description: Delete a contact and all associated events. Irreversible.

toolsPreview.name: get_contact_timeline
toolsPreview.description: Get a contact's full activity timeline: emails received, events fired, opens, clicks, automation enrollments, topic changes.

toolsPreview.name: get_contact_health_score
toolsPreview.description: Get a contact's 0-100 health score based on recent engagement (opens, clicks, replies).

toolsPreview.name: send_broadcast
toolsPreview.description: One-shot broadcast: create a campaign and immediately schedule it to send, in a single call. Pass either an audienceId, segmentId, topicId, or fully-qualified filter. Provide html OR templateSlug.

toolsPreview.name: schedule_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Schedule (or send immediately) an existing draft campaign to an audience/segment/topic.

toolsPreview.name: update_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Update a draft campaign: name, subject, preview text, sender info, HTML content, and/or recipients. Retarget with exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll, then verify with preview_campaign_recipients before sending. Only drafts can be edited.

toolsPreview.name: pause_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Pause a sending campaign. Already-sent messages are unaffected; remaining sends halt.

toolsPreview.name: resume_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Resume a paused campaign.

toolsPreview.name: duplicate_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Duplicate a campaign (template, content, and settings) as a new draft — works on sent campaigns too, so this is the way to re-use a past campaign's design. Optionally rename and retarget in the same call (exactly ONE of audienceIds / segmentId / contactIds / tagIds / sendToAll). NOTE: without retargeting, the copy keeps the ORIGINAL campaign's recipients.

toolsPreview.name: delete_campaign
toolsPreview.description: Delete a draft campaign. Sent campaigns cannot be deleted (only archived).

toolsPreview.name: preview_campaign_recipients
toolsPreview.description: Preview the recipient set for a campaign before sending. Returns count + sample list.

toolsPreview.name: activate_automation
toolsPreview.description: Activate an automation. New events matching its triggers will start enrolling contacts.

toolsPreview.name: pause_automation
toolsPreview.description: Pause an automation. Existing enrollments freeze in place; no new contacts enroll.

toolsPreview.name: get_automation_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get aggregate analytics for an automation: total enrollments, completed, exited, open/click rates per step.

toolsPreview.name: list_automation_enrollments
toolsPreview.description: List active and historical enrollments for an automation.

toolsPreview.name: list_workspaces
toolsPreview.description: List workspaces the authenticated user has access to (owner or member).

toolsPreview.name: get_workspace
toolsPreview.description: Get the current workspace (the one the API key belongs to).

toolsPreview.name: get_brand
toolsPreview.description: Get the workspace's brand settings: colors, logo, fonts, and the DESIGN.md spec injected into AI generation prompts.

toolsPreview.name: update_brand
toolsPreview.description: Update workspace brand settings. The designSpec field is a Markdown DESIGN.md document fed into AI generation system prompts — use it to encode voice, do/don't lists, and visual rules.

toolsPreview.name: get_workspace_usage
toolsPreview.description: Get the current month's send count, contact count, and plan limits.

toolsPreview.name: list_suppressions
toolsPreview.description: List suppressed email addresses (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes, manual).

toolsPreview.name: add_suppression
toolsPreview.description: Add an email to the suppression list. Future sends to this address will be blocked.

toolsPreview.name: remove_suppression
toolsPreview.description: Remove an email from the suppression list. Use only when you've confirmed the recipient wants to receive mail again.

toolsPreview.name: list_webhooks
toolsPreview.description: List configured outgoing webhooks (your endpoints that Send16 POSTs delivery events to). Outgoing webhooks are a plan feature.

toolsPreview.name: create_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Register an outgoing webhook endpoint. Send16 POSTs event JSON to this URL with an HMAC-SHA256 signature. Outgoing webhooks are a plan feature.

toolsPreview.name: delete_webhook
toolsPreview.description: Delete an outgoing webhook endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: regenerate_webhook_secret
toolsPreview.description: Rotate the HMAC signing secret for an outgoing webhook endpoint. Returns the new secret once.
